entries.description: One newly authored complete empty vacuum-former-style desktop machine exterior. One long side lever and cross-grip, a blank front control face and four complete grounded pads belong to this single integrated machine. All geometry newly drawn, no old screen-print frame, cup-sealer head, appliance case or grille imported. Unlike the raised mesh screen over a cantilever garment platen, the new table is a perforated plate inside a deep well and the raised clamp has no mesh; the independent rear retracted hood and side table lever are part of the whole relation. Unlike the cup-sealer there are no paired supply rolls, stretched film web or extended circular tray. entries.title: Fixed Twin Eccentric and Curved Slot Link
entries.description: One complete newly authored fixed twin-eccentric curved-link mechanical exhibit. Two displaced complete discs share one transverse shaft in two bored pedestal bearings; each disc has its own full encircling annular strap and long connecting rod to a different end of a single thick curved slotted link. The curved link has a genuine continuous curved through opening and finite closed end bridges. A separate block occupies the middle slot, with its complete output stem offset in front of the link and passing through an independent bored guide on the common low grounded bed. A fixed rear support and actual visible pins keep the artistic arrangement coherent. Unlike the old direct-pin straight yoke there are paired eccentric straps and rods feeding a separate curved intermediary; unlike the old crosshead drive there is no piston chamber, flywheel or single rod directly driving a slider. entries.title: Fixed Long Neck And Cross Pivot Bulb Bird
entries.description: One newly authored complete long-neck bulb-bird toy appearance in a fixed forward-leaning pose.
